name: Cosmo Router
description: Open-source, Apache 2.0 GraphQL Federation router written in Go, part of the WunderGraph Cosmo platform.

capabilities.note: In progress in the router's engine ([branch](https://github.com/wundergraph/graphql-go-tools/tree/on-error-spec-update))

defer.note: Off by default; enable with `engine.enable_defer`. Implements `incrementalSpec=v0.2` and rejects clients that ask for the older `deferSpec=20220824` format. Versions 0.328.0 to 0.352.x used the older format ([doc](https://cosmo-docs.wundergraph.com/router/defer))

empty-abstract-types.note: Empty interfaces and unions are rejected

graphql-over-http.note: GET and POST are supported, but responses always use `application/json`

on-error.note: In progress in the router's engine ([branch](https://github.com/wundergraph/graphql-go-tools/tree/on-error-spec-update))

persisted-documents.note: The protocol for persisted documents is still TBD ([doc](https://cosmo-docs.wundergraph.com/router/persisted-queries/persisted-operations))

semantic-non-null.note: Kept in the client schema, but the router does nothing with it. Requires composition 0.45.0 and wgc 0.93.1 ([doc](https://cosmo-docs.wundergraph.com/federation/directives/semanticnonnull))

specified-by.note: Subgraphs accept it, but composition strips it, so clients never see it ([doc](https://cosmo-docs.wundergraph.com/federation/directives/specifiedby))

subscriptions.note: Over graphql-ws, SSE, multipart HTTP and legacy protocols ([doc](https://cosmo-docs.wundergraph.com/router/subscriptions))
